entry.title: Dedicated music selection block
entry.notes: Music selection takes substantial time. Budget a dedicated 30–45-minute session for auditioning tracks against the actual footage; do not assume the entire music pass will fit in one session. Match rhythm, tempo and emotional tone to playback speed. Gentle atmospheric tracks may clash with sped-up work montages; test a more defined, upbeat rhythmic pulse. Keep music on separate Premiere Pro audio tracks for easy replacement.
